messages:
sanjay-pm: Quick one — we need a 60m design review next week for three small but interdependent items: Edge Routing API (v2), SDK auth token refresh, and a Console UX tile that surfaces routing/cost hints. Prefer Tuesday/Wednesday. Can folks +1 availability and call out any mandatory pre-read they need?

rachel-platform: +1 for Tue/Wed mornings (PST). prefer Tue 10-11am PT if that works. I'll book a room.

maria-ux: +1. Would love the slot if Tue 10 works. I'll upload the Console mockups and a short flows doc to the pre-read.

lee-eng: Tue 10 is fine for me. Need the API surface doc (openapi) and SDK auth proposal before EOD Monday so I can do a quick pass.

aj-ml: leaning +1 — depends on Edge Routing API perf assumptions. If the pre-read includes expected p99 latencies / routing fallback rules, I can weigh in.

sanjay-pm: Thanks — plan: Tue 10-11 PT. I'll send a calendar hold. Pre-read asks: 1) short one-pager (why change, impact, rollout constraints), 2) OpenAPI + example client snippet, 3) Console mockups + acceptance criteria, 4) migration plan and rollback triggers. Try to keep each doc < 5 slides/pages.

rachel-platform: booking sent (calendar invite). Added "Design Review — Edge API / SDK auth / Console hints" and link to the working doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/designs/edge-sdk-console-prep — please add files to that folder.

maria-ux: uploaded mockups v1 and an annotated user-flow (08:15). Notes: Console tile should be able to show route confidence and cost-estimate per-request. Acceptance criteria in the mock is under "notes/criteria.md".

lee-eng: uploaded OpenAPI sketch + client example in examples/openapi-client.md (09:02). Quick note: SDK token refresh will be opt-in for now, default unchanged.

aj-ml: pasted performance assumptions in docs/perf-assumptions.md (09:15). p50/p95/p99 for routing selection, fallback to smaller model for overloaded regions. Please call out SLA targets in the one-pager.

design-bot: PRE-READ CHECKLIST GENERATED — Please ensure the following are in the doc folder before EOD Mon:
• one-pager (goals, constraints, rollout plan)
• API spec (OpenAPI or endpoint list)
• SDK snippet + migration notes
• Console mockups + acceptance criteria
• Rollout/rollback triggers + monitoring signals
• Short list of open questions for reviewers

sanjay-pm: added a short rollout timeline in docs/timeline.md (09:24): canary -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 2 weeks with automatic rollback on increased error-rate or latency spike >15% over baseline.

rachel-platform: heads-up — we may need eng-sre on the invite for rollout runbook reviews. @lee-eng can you add a brief runbook section or link to existing runbook?

lee-eng: will add runbook excerpt to docs/runbook.md (09:35). Also tagging @deploy-bot to remind on deploy window (no Fridays).

deploy-bot: reminder: deploy windows available Tue/Wed 0900-1600 PT. If you request outside that, please note exceptions and approvals.

maria-ux: two quick asks for reviewers: 1) prioritize Console acceptance criteria feedback (pretty time-sensitive), 2) flag any security concerns with token refresh plan.

aj-ml: question — are we expecting routing decisions to be deterministic in the SDK or server-side only? That affects how we show confidence in Console.

sanjay-pm: routing decisions remain server-side for now; SDK will expose a routing_hint only. Will add that to the SDK snippet.

lee-eng: last note — if anyone has performance trace examples, add a small sample log snippet to docs/perf-examples.txt so we can discuss during the review.

sanjay-pm: awesome. If no objections, agenda for Tue 10-11 PT: 10:00 — intro + goals (5m)
10:05 — API design + SDK changes (20m)
10:25 — Console mockups + acceptance criteria (15m)
10:40 — Rollout plan, monitoring, runbooks (10m)
10:50 — Open questions / decisions / next steps (10m)

rachel-platform: perfect. I'll ping eng-sre and customer-ops to join the last 20 mins for rollout discussion.

maria-ux: thanks — I'll make the mockups clickable for the demo.

lee-eng: will try to have a lightweight demo of the SDK snippet ready.

aj-ml: adding a short note on routing metrics to the perf doc.

sanjay-pm: thanks all — closing the loop. If you add anything to the folder after EOD Mon, ping here so reviewers see updates. :thumbsup:
